_: The Undergarden, from All the Mods 10's census (W4 R9, judged 2026-11-12), as 1.20.1's file has them from All the Mods 9's, with dreadrock beside them. Deepsoil and coarse deepsoil are the bare earth of the Undergarden's floor, and the rules refuse them for the soil in their names, which they read as worked ground; depthrock and dreadrock are its natural rock, and the rules leave them out for having no stone word. Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Deepsoil farmland and the rocks' bricks, tiles, polished forms, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules, its ores are excluded, and the deepturfs, sediment and shiverstone already wear by detection.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.21.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
